source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeCB62ApexPagesEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { ApexPages.Action action = new ApexPages.Action('list'); System.assertEquals('list', action.getExpression()); ApexPages.Message msg = new ApexPages.Message(ApexPages.Severity.FATAL, 'fatal'); System.assertEquals(ApexPages.Severity.FATAL, msg.getSeverity()); } }
